name: dr-cockpit
description: A Claude Code mod for long sessions: a band that warns as the main session nears its handoff budget, a pane of subagent seats and their token use, and a guard that keeps AI attribution out of commits and pull requests.

handoffTokens.title: Handoff budget (tokens)
handoffTokens.description: Context size at which the band says hand off. 0 follows DR_SUPERPOWERS_BUDGET, else dr-superpowers' rule: 93% of the window minus 140,000.

nudgeModel.title: Tell the model at the budget
nudgeModel.description: In a session running dr-superpowers, add one note to the conversation when the main session crosses its handoff budget.

guardAttribution.title: Keep AI attribution out of git
guardAttribution.description: Drop the commit trailer and pull request footer Claude Code asks for, and refuse commits and pull requests that still carry AI attribution.
